title: Undergraduate Research Internship: Theoretical Physics
institution: Max Planck Institute for the Physics of Complex Systems (MPI-PKS)
about: Summer 2027 undergraduate research internship at the Max Planck Institute for the Physics of Complex Systems, offering pre-PhD research experience of about two months to promising students in the penultimate or final undergraduate year. Applications are due 20 November 2026.
requirements: Particularly promising undergraduate students in the penultimate or final year of undergraduate studies
Internship of roughly two months in summer 2027
